sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# SPACE to see where it teleports
result = action(['SPACE'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Player at ({b[0][0]}, {b[0][1]})")

# Find all major entities
for color_name, color_char in [('Orange X', 'O'), ('Red diamond', 'r'), ('Blue cross', 'b')]:
    nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == color_char and n['pixels'] > 10]
    if nodes:
        for n in nodes:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            print(f"{color_name}: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers: {len(containers)}")
for c in containers:
    b = c['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  at ({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

print(f"Score: {last_action_result.get('score')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
